name: Annual leave (วันหยุดพักผ่อนประจำปี)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.30: not less than 6 working days a year after one year of continuous service (pro rata earlier only if the employer grants it, not presumed); s.64 pays untaken leave; s.67: on a termination other than under s.119, the leave of the year of termination in proportion to the year served (here 6 × the days of the year to the exit day ÷ the days of the year) is paid; none for the year of a s.119 dismissal (exit fact section_119_ground); s.56 pays the days.

entitlement.days: service_months >= 12.0 ? (has(employment.exit_date) && employment.exit_date != "" && as_of != null && as_of >= employment.exit_date ? (has(employment.exit_facts) && employment.exit_facts != null && has(employment.exit_facts.section_119_ground) && employment.exit_facts.section_119_ground ? 0.0 : round(6.0 * (calendar_distance_days(employment.exit_date.substring(0, 4) + "-01-01", employment.exit_date) + 1.0) / calendar_distance_days(employment.exit_date.substring(0, 4) + "-01-01", add_years(employment.exit_date.substring(0, 4) + "-01-01", 1)), 0.01, "HALF_UP")) : 6.0) : 0.0

name: Sick leave (ลาป่วย)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.32: leave for actual sickness; a medical certificate may be required for three working days or more; s.57: wages for up to 30 working days a year. An entry for a work injury or work-caused sickness records facts.work_injury true; it raises the WCA s.48 notification task.

name: Sick leave beyond 30 paid days
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.32 with s.57: sick leave is not capped, but wages are owed for at most 30 working days a year; the further days are unpaid.

name: Personal business leave (ลากิจ)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.34: not less than 3 working days a year for necessary business; s.57/1: paid for up to 3 days a year.

name: Sterilisation leave (ลาเพื่อทำหมัน)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.33: leave for sterilisation and for the period a physician certifies; s.57 para 2: paid.

name: Military service leave (ลารับราชการทหาร)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.35: leave to be inspected, call-up or trained under the military service law; s.58: paid for up to 60 days a year.

name: Training leave (ลาฝึกอบรม)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.36: leave for training or development under the rules the Ministerial Regulation prescribes; the Act owes no wages for it.

name: Maternity leave, employer-paid days (ลาคลอด)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.41 (before the No. 9 amendment): up to 98 days for each pregnancy, including prenatal examination and holidays; s.59: wages for up to 45 days. Metered per pregnancy (entry.facts.event_id): the employer-paid days here, the rest as MATERNITY_LEAVE_SSO.

name: Maternity leave, days without employer pay
authority: The days of s.41 maternity leave beyond the employer's s.59 wages; 98 less 45 days. Social Security Act B.E. 2533 (1990) s.67: the insured mother receives the maternity cash benefit from the Social Security Fund (50% of wages for 90 days).

name: Traditional holidays (วันหยุดตามประเพณี)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.29: not less than 13 days a year including National Labour Day (1 May), announced in advance; a holiday falling on a weekly holiday is replaced on the next working day; s.56(2): paid.

name: Unpaid leave by agreement
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5 and s.70: wages are owed for work and for the paid leave the Act lists (ss.56-59); other leave agreed with the employer is unpaid.
